notes: S1 disabled (engine=strategy2.py). 2026-09-09 session: NO STRATEGY PARAMETER CHANGES; every S2 constant is owner-locked and n=20, EV +0.171R, t=+0.49 (+0.54 sigma from breakeven) justifies moving none of them. THE FINDING -- THE SUPERVISION SECTION NAMED THE WRONG CAUSE FOR THREE STRAIGHT NIGHTS, AND THE WRONG CAUSE WAS A FIVE-SECOND FIX. On 2026-09-08 the 02:00 session and both its retries (04:30, 15:00) died on 'Your organization has disabled Claude subscription access for Claude Code'. The report told Kamran the causes were (02:00) a settings.json permission typo and (04:30, 15:00) 'MODE: --retry (no successful session yet today)' -- which is self_improve.sh's OWN BANNER. None of the three named the real cause. Root cause: analyze._session_history picked the reason as body.splitlines()[0], a guess about WHERE the harness prints a fatal error. It was right for 14 of 17 historical failures BY COINCIDENCE, never by rule, and that coincidence is exactly why nobody audited it. It broke in both available ways at once: a benign permission warning appeared ABOVE the error, and on the two retry paths our own MODE banner is line 1 BY CONSTRUCTION -- so every retry failure has been misreported since the retry mechanism shipped on 09-01. Cost: three days of unsupervised trading behind a diagnosis pointing at a config typo that would have changed nothing, while the actual fix is account-level and only Kamran can make it. FIXED: analyze._failure_reason() classifies on the INVARIANT instead of the position -- a line that also OPENS a session which exited 0 cannot explain a different session's non-zero exit (the permission warning opens two sessions that exited 0, so it is provably benign). Among survivors take the FIRST, because the harness prints the cause above its remediation hints (2026-08-20: 'claude native binary not installed' above 'Or reinstall without --ignore-scripts'). Verified against all 17 historical failures: every one now names a real cause, and the four dedicated paths (usage limits, exit 124) are unchanged. SELF-POISONING GUARD, and it is the subtle part: the benign set is harvested from the FIRST line of a successful body only, never the whole body -- a successful body contains the entire session report, and that report routinely QUOTES the error strings being attributed (this note does). Harvesting full bodies would launder tonight's diagnosis into tomorrow's benign set and silently re-break the function. Pinned by test_session_reason.py case 6. SECOND FIX -- OPEN BOOK NOW PRINTS WHERE THE POSITION IS, NOT ONLY WHERE IT HAS BEEN. Every line in that section was either an excursion (MFE/MAE, which only ever ratchets up) or a consistency check between recorded fields; none said what the trade is worth NOW. Live consequence: on 09-07 the report showed the ETH SHORT at 'MFE +2.02R' and the session read that as a trade near its arming threshold. Two days later those two lines are byte-identical while the position has round-tripped to +0.29R -- IT HAS GIVEN BACK 1.73R, 86% OF ITS PEAK, and the report said nothing. Now prints NOW +x.xxR from price_series (the tracker's own poll record, so the report stays a pure function of state.json and makes no network call) plus an explicit GIVEN BACK line when a >=0.5R peak has surrendered >=0.5R. ADDED test_session_reason.py, 17 assertions across 9 cases; case 9 sha256s the production selflearn.log to prove the suite never writes to it (the test_ratchet.py case-8 lesson from 08-24). All 16 suites green. DID NOT CHANGE: every S2 constant (owner-locked). Did not run apply_config_to_trader (no S1 value moved; it rewrites trader.py for nothing). Did not edit /root/.claude/settings.json to correct Write(/opt/vps-backup/**) -> Edit(...): it is outside the project, Edit() is a BROADER grant than Write(), and silently widening a permission rule unattended is the owner's call -- and it is now proven benign, so it fixes no failure. LIVE RISK CARRIED FORWARD: the ETH SHORT is 130h old, entry 2509.6, stop still 2558.66 (-1.00R, locked_r 0.0), MFE +2.02R, NOW +0.29R. It is the SECOND trade to reach >=2.0R without arming at TRAIL_START_R=2.50, and unlike the closed ones its excursion is UNCENSORED -- trades that arm are closed at 2.5R by construction, so the open book is the only place an honest observation above 2.0R can be made.
